description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Order to declare the areas of Yudaganawa Raja Maha Vihara to be an urban development area
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on land-related matters, specifically declaring the "Yudaganawa Raja Maha Vihara Sacred Area" as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It contains detailed land descriptions including extent (25.4840 Hectares), surveyor general's tracing numbers, and precise boundary information. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of the document, which is land designation and planning. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3 classification.
